character_data.title: DynTAC 1973X
character_data.text: 划时代的通讯工具，亦是经济腾飞伊始，身份的象征。受访者亲戚赠送的珍贵生日礼，尽管笨重却可将亲人朋友的问候与寒暄随时携带。如今，“大砖头”是独属于一位密友的栖息地，唯独受访者掌握着拜访的密钥。

character_data.title: 执夜人制服
character_data.text:
不舍昼夜的努力、从未松懈的自律与对真相公义的笃信，共同织就了受访者身着的制服。
“所作所为决不能辜负执夜人的荣誉。”受访者音量不大，却掷地有声。

character_data.title: “传承者”
character_data.text: 一种图腾，一种责任，亦是一段历史。直到惊雷响过，这副面具交由年幼的受访者戴上，祖辈年年岁岁的夙愿才有了回应。受访者称，一周需对面具做三次护养，才能使其崭新如初，避免再度蒙尘。

character_data.title: 最后的方相氏
character_data.text:
时值腊月初七，星回日穷，一年将尽。按照节令，此时须举行祭礼、驱除疫鬼，才能行四时之气，使百物苏生。于是群臣百官聚集在宫中，羽林军沿阶而立。宫城之外，一切农人、商贾、工匠也都献上祭品，就连经过的贤者都满怀敬仰，垂手而立。
“侲子备，请逐疫。”
中黄门唱诵咒语，侲僮们齐声应和。肃然的目光中，方相氏执戈扬盾，飒沓起舞，呼险道兽威名。它们在赤发白衣的侲僮身边次第显形，一条条麻鞭摇荡起舞，驱神兽、逐恶鬼，一切如仪。

——但这一年仍有些不同。
大鸿胪已宣布礼毕，但险道兽依然迟迟不肯离去。侲僮们静静等候方相氏吩咐，却等来一份意料之外的重托。
“方相之裔，至于余身，已绝其绪……”
侲僮们相视愕然，他们这才注意到，年年玄衣朱裳的方相氏，早已须发皆白。
身旁的强梁低低地向他咆哮。这一日，他和众位侲僮一起，各自以受托的险道兽之名改换了姓氏，立下共同卫戍黎民的誓言。

character_data.title: 手提电话
character_data.text:
梁月：您好，我是梁月，很荣幸作为夜巡特遣管理局的见习执夜人代表，接受您的采访……
白雪松：打住，打住。这不是一场面试，我不是来听你打官腔的。你只需当做是一场闲聊就好。
梁月：噢，好的。您有什么想聊的吗？
白雪松：许多读者对你的“险道兽”强梁很有兴趣。我们注意到，你用来召唤它的工具并非特制的神秘学物品，而是一个现代通讯设备。
梁月：是的。这是一部手提电话，我的同学和同事们更喜欢叫它——大哥大。
白雪松：神秘学存在与现代科技设备兼容得很好，这种情况很少见。它就住在里面？
梁月：这部手提电话并非某种空间类神秘术的载体。强梁居住在与现实世界完全不同的空间里，这部大哥大更像是我们之间的桥梁，我们通过它找到彼此。
白雪松：真可惜。我还好奇过它是否能随时随地给手提电话充电。
梁月：恰恰相反，强梁经常从里面汲取电力，尤其是需要恢复力量的时候……我每月都要为它支付高额的电费。
白雪松：你的意思是，强梁的每一道雷光，都来自我们的火力、水力或核发电厂？
梁月：……至少有一部分如此，我想。

character_data.title: 任逍遥
character_data.text:
受访者的师父赠予的斗笠。藤条边缘编有一圈甲片，四周的穗带则用厌胜钱交错串起，以免阻挡佩戴者的视线。
“花钱也是师父给我的，据说能驱邪纳福。不管是真是假，祝福一定是真的。”

character_voice.jpcontent: 静坐瞑想は非常に苦しいものでした。指先を動かしただけで、父上に叱られてしまいますから。#0|ですが、静坐の場所をベランダに変えると、ラジオが聞こえるようになりました。「じゃんじゃんじゃじゃーん――ラッパちゃんのラジオ放送！」#9.9|それからは、お楽しみの時間へと変わりました。#24.7
character_voice.kocontent: 명상 정좌가 가장 견디기 힘들었어요. 손끝이 떨리기만 해도 아버지가 꾸짖었거든요. #0|나중에 베란다에 앉아 있는데 마침 옆집 라디오 소리가 들리더군요. ‘빠라빠라... 꼬마 나팔 방송을 시작합니다!’ #9.5|그렇게 명상은 하루 중 가장 기대되는 시간이 됐죠.#21.7

If so much as a fingertip trembled, Father would scold me.#0|But when I started meditating on the balcony, I could hear the radio broadcast from next door. "Da-di-da! Welcome to the show!"#8.5|Then it became the highlight of my day.#19.8
character_voice.twcontent: 冥想靜坐是最難熬的，只是指尖顫動，都會引來爸爸一句責駡。#0|後來我就坐在陽臺上，那裡恰好能聽見隔壁收音機的聲音，“嗒滴答——小喇叭開始廣播啦！”#6.8|於是，靜修成了一天中我最期待的時刻。#16.7

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 您好，长官，我正记录着道奇体育馆魔精斗殴的相关警情。#0|保持警惕，时刻关注，是执夜队所教的第一课。#4.4
character_voice.encontent: Hello, ma'am. I'm writing a report on the critter brawl at Dodger Stadium.#0|The first thing we learn as Vigiles is to always stay alert and always stay informed.#4.3
character_voice.twcontent: 您好，長官，我正記錄著道奇體育館魔精鬥毆的相關警情。#0|保持警惕，時刻關注，是執夜隊所教的第一課。#4.4
character_voice.jpcontent: お疲れ様です、長官。現在ドジャー・スタジアムにて発生した魔精乱闘事件に関する情報を記録しています。#0|常に警戒を怠らず。それが<marktop=ウィギレス>夜廻員</marktop>としての基本ですから。#10
character_voice.kocontent: 안녕하세요, 다저 스타디움에서 벌어진 크리터 난투극에 대한 보고서를 작성하고 있어요. #0|경계를 유지하면서 항상 상황을 파악하는 게 야간 순찰대에서 가장 먼저 배우는 내용이죠.#5.9

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 从前，清晨五点时，您就能听见我妈妈的念叨——像“早起的鸟儿有虫吃”之类的话。#0|后来，分局早晨充斥着咖啡的热气、埃尔登警长的叱骂、彻夜呼啸的警讯红灯……#8.2|呼，妈妈可不用再操心了。#15.6
character_voice.encontent: Back home, my mother would wake me up at five a.m., saying things like "the early bird gets the worm."#0|But five a.m. at the DAA is wide awake: coffee brewing, sirens blaring, and Chief Elden scolding.#7.4|*sigh* I suppose my mother had nothing to worry about.#17
character_voice.twcontent: 從前，清晨五點時，您就能聽見我媽媽的念叨——像“早起的鳥兒有蟲吃”之類的話。#0|後來，分局早晨充斥著咖啡的熱氣、埃爾登警長的叱駡、徹夜呼嘯的警訊紅燈……#8.2|呼，媽媽可不用再操心了。#15.6
character_voice.jpcontent: 昔は朝５時になると、母上に「早起きは三文の徳よ」と言われながら起こされていました。#0|ですが、対策課に入ると――朝からコーヒーの香りや、エルデン課長の罵る声、ひっきりなしのサイレンで…#9.4|ふぅ、もう母上の小言を聞くこともなさそうですね。#22.9
character_voice.kocontent: 예전엔 새벽 5시면 엄마가 "일찍 일어나는 새가 벌레를 잡아먹는다" 같은 말로 저를 깨우셨어요. #0|하지만 지청에선 아침이 밝아오면 커피 열기와 엘든 부국장님의 호통, 밤새 울리는 사이렌 소리로 가득 차죠... #10.4|하아, 엄마가 더는 걱정하지 않아도 될 거예요.#19.5

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 小时候，天还未亮，我就已经在公园里跑步了。#0|人与街道都还睡着，直到某一刻，路边的灯熄了，一切迅速苏醒过来。#4.3|那时候，沉重的呼吸会被朝阳托住，变得很轻。#13
character_voice.encontent: When I was little, I would run in the park before sunrise.#0|The world was sound asleep until the sunlight grew enough for the streetlights to shut off.#4.2|And as the sky grew lighter, so too did my breathing.#10.2
character_voice.twcontent: 小時候，天還未亮，我就已經在公園裡跑步了。#0|人與街道都還睡著，直到某一刻，路邊的燈熄了，一切迅速甦醒過來。#4.3|那時候，沉重的呼吸會被朝陽托住，變得很輕。#13
character_voice.jpcontent: 幼い頃は、日の出前から公園を走っていました。#0|街灯が消え、すべてが目を覚まし、#5.6|重かった呼吸が、太陽の光で軽くなるのを感じたものです。#9.7
character_voice.kocontent: 어렸을 때는 해가 뜨기 전에 공원에서 뛰곤 했어요. #0|사람도 거리도 모두 잠들어 있었는데, 어느 순간이 되면 가로등이 꺼지고 모든 것이 빠르게 깨어나죠. #5.4|그때가 되면 무겁던 호흡도 아침 햇살에 떠올라 가벼워져요.#16.4

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 我在望日出生，月亮最圆满的时候。#0|于是，妈妈把它摘下放进我的名字。#4.3|后来我又知道，不管离家多远，同一轮月亮都会看护着我们……#8.6|我得找个能看见月亮的地方才行。#17.8
character_voice.encontent: I was born on the day of the full moon.#0|That's why my mother named me Yue.#2.6|Later, I realized that no matter how far from home we are, the same moon always watches over us ...#5.8|I have to go find a place where I can see the moon.#16.2
character_voice.twcontent: 我在望日出生，月亮最圓滿的時候。#0|於是，媽媽把它摘下放進我的名字。#4.3|後來我又知道，不管離家多遠，同一輪月亮都會看護著我們……#8.6|我得找個能看見月亮的地方才行。#17.8
character_voice.jpcontent: 私は<marktop=ぼうじつ>望日</marktop>に…月が満ちた時に生まれました。#0|母上はそれにちなんで、私を月と名付けたのです。#6.6|例え故郷がどれだけ離れていようとも、同じ月が私たちを見守ってくれている…#13|月の見えるところに行かなくては。#21.7
character_voice.kocontent: 전 보름날에 태어났어요. 달이 가장 동그랄 때죠. #0|그래서 엄마가 그걸로 제 이름을 지어 주셨어요. #5.8|그리고 나중에 알게 됐죠. 집에서 아무리 멀리 있어도 달이 우리를 지켜준다는 것을요... #10.7|전 달이 보이는 곳을 찾아야 해요.#19.3

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 在深夜，将一位母亲从孩童的身边带走，不是一件容易的事。#0|我能做的，只有在任务结束后，陪孩子把没能和妈妈一起完成的纸牌屋仔细搭好。#7.7
character_voice.encontent: It wasn't easy to arrest that woman, taking her away from her child in the middle of the night.#0|All I could do was pay a visit after the case closed and help the kid finish the house of cards they'd been building together.#6.2
character_voice.twcontent: 在深夜，將一位母親從孩童的身邊帶走，不是一件容易的事。#0|我能做的，只有在任務結束後，陪孩子把沒能和媽媽一起完成的紙牌屋仔細搭好。#7.7
character_voice.jpcontent: その昔、深夜に子どもから母親を引き剥がすという、心が痛む仕事をしたことがあります。#0|私にできることといえば、任務の終わりに母親と立てていたであろうトランプタワーの手伝いをしてあげることくらいでした。#10.3
character_voice.kocontent: 한밤중에 아이 곁에 있는 어머니를 체포하는 건 쉬운 일이 아니에요. #0|제가 할 수 있는 건 임무가 끝난 뒤, 아이가 자기 엄마와 완성하지 못한 카드 탑을 함께 쌓아 올려주는 것뿐이죠.#6

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 长发也要干净利落，追捕犯人时才能起到最大作用——#0|被风吹过，绝不添乱。#4.5
character_voice.encontent: Long hair must always be neatly tied up so as not to obstruct the line of duty.#0|You wouldn't want hair in your face when you're chasing a criminal.#5.5
character_voice.twcontent: 長髮也要乾淨俐落，追捕犯人時才能起到最大作用——#0|被風吹過，絕不添亂。#4.5
character_voice.jpcontent: 長い髪もしなやかであれば、業務に影響しません。#0|風に吹かれたところで、乱れませんから。#4.9
character_voice.kocontent: 긴 머리는 업무에 방해가 되지 않도록 항상 단정하게 묶어야 해요. #0|범죄자를 쫓을 때 얼굴에 머리카락이 날리지 않도록 말이에요.#5.2

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 打电话？自然可行，看，正常地拨通了。#0|当然，要是打扰了强梁的好梦，它也会不满的——#7.9|如今，我很庆幸还能从电话里听见它的声音。#13.5
character_voice.encontent: Of course it can make calls. See?#0|I just seldom use it as a normal phone in case I disturb Qiangliang's rest. But I guess that's better than never hearing from it again—#5.5|I'm just glad to have the chance to upset it at all.#15
character_voice.twcontent: 打電話？自然可行，看，正常地撥通了。#0|當然，要是打擾了強梁的好夢，它也會不滿的——#7.9|如今，我很慶幸還能從電話裡聽見它的聲音。#13.5
character_voice.jpcontent: 電話ですか？　できますよ。はい、このように。#0|強梁のお昼寝を邪魔することもありますし、不満に思われるかもしれませんが…#7.1|今の私は声が聞けるだけでも嬉しいです。#14.6
character_voice.kocontent: 전화요? 당연히 되죠. 보이시죠? #0|강량의 휴식을 방해할까 봐 일반 전화기로는 거의 사용하지 않아요... #4.4|그래도 강량과 연락을 못하는 것보다는 낫다고 생각해요.#11

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 衣服脱下后要及时挂好，穿前要熨平褶皱。#0|无论什么服装，都要笔挺利落地穿在身上。#4|长辈们总说，要学会承担责任，就要从这些小事做起……#8.2|长官，您这儿，应该没有这样的要求吧？#14.4
character_voice.encontent: Hang your clothes immediately after taking them off, and iron them before wearing them.#0|Whether in your daily clothes or ceremonial attire, you should always look neat.#5.4|My family elders say that a competent successor should be responsible, and that starts with the little things.#10.7|We don't have any rules like that here, do we?#18.4
character_voice.twcontent: 衣服脫下後要及時掛好，穿前要熨平褶皺。#0|無論什麼服裝，都要筆挺俐落地穿在身上。#4|長輩們總說，要學會承擔責任，就要從這些小事做起……#8.2|長官，您這裡，應該沒有這樣的要求吧？#14.4
character_voice.jpcontent: 服は脱いだらハンガーに、着る前にはしわを伸ばすように。#0|どのような装いであったとしても、しっかりと着こなすこと…#6|大人になるには、些細なことからコツコツと――と、よく言われていたのですが…#12.6|ここではそういうルール…ないですよね？#22.3
character_voice.kocontent: 옷을 벗으면 바로 잘 걸어놓고, 입기 전에는 잘 다려야 합니다. #0|어떤 옷이든 단정하게 입어야 하죠. #5.4|어른들은 항상 책임지는 걸 배우려면 이런 사소한 일부터 시작해야 한다고 말씀하시는데... #9.1|여기서는 그런 조건이 없겠죠?#18

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 在老家，人们都爱往录像厅跑。我也不例外，但我得挑准时间。#0|每周三晚上九点之后，是我的黄金时段。#7|趁着爸妈值夜班，到“少年宫录像厅”买张票，和好多人挤在一条长凳上，#10.7|两毛钱就能看整晚的《神秘警探C07》。#17.5
character_voice.encontent: In my hometown, people loved to go to the video room. I did too, but I had to choose my timing carefully.#0|On Wednesday's after 9 p.m., my parents worked the night shift.#7|That was when I'd sneak out to the Youth Palace with two Jiao in my pocket#10.7|and squeeze onto the bench to watch Detective C07.#17.8
character_voice.twcontent: 在老家，人們都愛往錄影廳跑。我也不例外，但我得挑好時間。#0|每週三晚上九點之後，是我的黃金時段。#7|趁著爸媽值夜班，到“少年宮錄影廳”買張票，和好多人擠在一條長凳上，#10.7|兩毛錢就能看整晚的《神秘警探C07》。#17.5
character_voice.jpcontent: 地元ではビデオルームが人気でした。私も好きでしたが、行けるのは限られた時間だけ。#0|毎週水曜日の夜９時以降、それが私の憩いの一時でした。#9.4|両親が夜勤の内にチケットを買って、長椅子に詰めて座れば、#18.2|<marktop=リャンジャオ>２角</marktop>で『刑事Ｃ０７』を一晩中観ることができたのです。#23.9
character_voice.kocontent: 고향 사람들은 다들 영화 감상실에 가는 걸 좋아했습니다. 저도 예외는 아니었지만, 타이밍을 잘 봐야 했죠. #0|매주 수요일 밤 9시 이후가 제 황금 시간대였어요. #10.7|부모님이 야근하시는 틈을 타서 몰래 ‘청소년 회관 영화 감상실’로 가서 표를 사면 여러 사람과 벤치에 붙어 앉아 #15.9|싼 가격에 밤새 <마도 형사 C07>을 볼 수 있었죠.#25

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 我想，“如何处理与长官的关系”也应该加入执夜队的培训内容。#0|毕竟，您与埃尔登警长的处事方式便截然不同……#5.9|长官，我很感谢您的和善。这让我来这儿的第一天，就轻松了不少。#11
character_voice.encontent: I think the Vigiles training should include a class on how to work with your supervisors.#0|Your style of doing things is quite different from Chief Elden's.#5.4|I must thank you for your kindness, ma'am. It made my first day much easier.#9.6
character_voice.twcontent: 我想，“如何處理與長官的關係”也應該加入執夜隊的培訓內容。#0|畢竟，您與埃爾登警長的處事方式便截然不同……#5.9|長官，我很感謝您的和善。這讓我來這裡的第一天，就輕鬆了不少。#11
character_voice.jpcontent: 長官との付き合い方も<marktop=ウィギレス>夜廻員</marktop>の研修に取り入れるべきだと思います。#0|あなたとエルデン課長の、仕事の仕方が違い過ぎるので…#6.6|ですが、あなたの優しさに感謝しています。ここにきてからというもの、随分と負担が減りましたから。#14.1
character_voice.kocontent: ‘상사와 관계를 잘 이어가는 법’도 야간 순찰대의 훈련 내용에 들어가야 한다고 생각해요. #0|타임키퍼는 엘든 부국장님과 일 처리 방식이 완전히 다르니까요... #6.8|호의에 감사드립니다. 덕분에 여기 온 첫날부터 많이 편안했어요.#13.7

character_voice.name: 亲昵

character_voice.encontent: For Qiangliang, everything in this era is fresh and intriguing, which explains why it's become so lively.#0|This is a new beginning—for both of us.#9.4
character_voice.twcontent: 如今，對強梁而言，萬事萬物都是新鮮的，它也因此活潑許多……#0|這是一個新的開始，對它是如此，對我也一樣。#7.6
character_voice.jpcontent: <marktop=きょうりょう>強梁</marktop>にとって、<marktop=こんだい>今代</marktop>は新しい物ばかりなので、以前より元気になっています。#0|これは新たな始まりです…<marktop=きょうりょう>強梁</marktop>にとっても、もちろん私にとっても。#9.5
character_voice.kocontent: 지금 강량에게는 모든 것이 새로워요. 그로 인해 많이 활발해졌죠... #0|이건 새로운 시작이에요. 강량에게도, 저에게도 모두 마찬가지예요.#7.7

character_voice.name: 主界面交互3
character_voice.content: 强梁威严，却并不凶暴。#0|我能感受到，它并不排斥您的接触。下次，您可以放心试试。#3
character_voice.encontent: Qiangliang may be fearsome, but it's not ferocious.#0|I can feel that it's open to your touch. You're welcome to give it a try next time.#3.7
character_voice.twcontent: 強梁威嚴，卻並不兇暴。#0|我能感受到，它並不排斥您的接觸。下次，您可以放心試試。#3
character_voice.jpcontent: 強梁は威厳がありますが、凶暴というわけではありません。#0|私にはわかります。嫌がってはいないので、次は安心して触れてあげてください。#5.8
character_voice.kocontent: 강량은 위엄이 있지만 절대 사납지는 않습니다. #0|타임키퍼와의 접촉을 거부하지 않는다는 게 느껴져요. 다음에는 안심하고 시도해 보세요.#4.6

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 北镇抚司缇骑梁月，领镇抚使之命，见过大人。#0
character_voice.encontent: Your Excellency, I'm Liang Yue, a Mounted Constable from the North Zhenfu Division, sent here to investigate a most serious incident.#0

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 此前多行走于中原，北方雪大，我倒不曾见过这般细雪景象。#0|早闻江南落雪清雅，适合品茗观赏。#6.76|在下虽是一介粗人，见到此景却也理解其中情趣。#10.02
character_voice.encontent: In the North, the snow falls rough and harsh, nothing like the soft flakes that fall here.#0|It's the kind of scene that feels like a perfect time for a cup of tea.#6.7|I'm not one for poetry, but it touches my heart in some way.#12.3

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 若论来日……百姓安居乐业，天下海晏河清，当然是最好。#0
character_voice.encontent: When I hope for the future ... nothing surpasses my desire that the people of the world prosper together in harmony.#0

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 稍微……不行，还在当值呢。#0|“慎始而敬终，终以不困。”#5.54|如此放松，岂能成事！#9.8
character_voice.encontent: Maybe I should rest my eyes ... No, not even for a second. I'm on duty.#0|"One shall not stumble when one starts with care and ends with wariness."#13.19|There's no excuse for carelessness.#19.8

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 这箱中天地竟也有昼夜交替，雨过天晴……#0|可惜这种神仙技艺终归难以普惠于天下。#4.64|若能泽被苍生，想必百姓再也不用求神拜鬼以求风调雨顺。#9.37
character_voice.encontent: It is fascinating to see how the weather changes day by day inside the Suitcase ...#0|Such a pity that we can't apply this marvelous technique beyond its confines.#6.09|That way there might not be so many unanswered prayers.#11.9

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 大人起得早，不妨先去进些朝食，今日我做了早餐。它的名字？#0|老家的人唤它“山洞梅花”，也没什么新奇的，其实就是包子。#8.05
character_voice.encontent: Oh, you're up early today, Your Excellency. I made breakfast. Would you like some?#0|These are "Tangbao"; we sometimes call them "Plum Blossoms in a Cave," but they're simply soup-filled buns.#7.3

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 箱中日夜变幻不同外界，最近起得越发晚了……#0|一日之计在于晨，该打起精神去做晨课了！#4.84
character_voice.encontent: I find myself waking later and later these days; could it be that there is some sort of time difference inside of this place?#0|At any rate, I must not waste the morning. Time for my exercises!#11.8

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 晚上好，大人。这么晚了还在巡房？#0|不过请放心，今夜是我轮值，尽可安心。#4.89
character_voice.encontent: Good evening, Your Excellency. It's late. Are you still out and about?#0|I will be on patrol tonight. So, please rest assured. There will be nothing to worry about.#6.4

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 大人，属下有一问不知当讲不当讲……#0|嗯，只是发现大人经常这个时候巡房。#3.98|不知是有什么说法？#7.89
character_voice.encontent: Your Excellency, there's a question I've been wondering ...#0|I often see you doing rounds through the Suitcase at this time of the day.#4.2|Have you some reason to come at this time?#8.5

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 此次朝廷派我来此地，本为调查城内异变。#0|只是朝廷身份在这里着实有些显眼，#3.5|师父便给了我一顶斗笠方便隐藏身份。他说只需戴上便无人能认出我。#6.24|起初我还将信将疑，只是见他神色着实真切，便也信了……现在想来怕是又被他骗了。#12.17
character_voice.encontent: I have been sent from the Imperial Court to investigate a most serious incident.#0|However, I'm aware my outfit could be eye-catching here.#5.3|That is why my master gave me this hat, so that whatever glances come my way, my identity would remain shrouded.#9.5|I was doubtful ... and now I fear your expression proves that it was but another lie.#18.1

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 这把刀是朝廷派发的，本身倒没什么特别的。#0|刀法有云：“刀有形而无心不锐，有心而无锋则利。”#4|我不过粗通皮毛，那些真正的高手甚至只需一根柳枝便可退敌。#10.36
character_voice.encontent: This blade? It's ordinary really—standard issue to all officers of the North Zhenfu Division.#0|They say that "one who masters the blade requires not a sharp edge to unleash its power."#6.9|But even if a true master could beat their enemies with a wooden stick, I'm still glad mine is sharp.#13.13

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 抱歉，强梁最近有些闹脾气，我刚刚尝试安抚了一下。#0|近来它几次想要现世玩耍，都因在下公务不便，脱不开身而作罢。#5.96|大人，梁月有个不情之请……不知这箱中可有地方方便它出来走动走动？#11.88
character_voice.encontent: Apologies, Qiangliang has been naughty these days. I was attempting to soothe it ...#0|Really, what it wants is to come out and play. But I've been so busy with my duties that I haven't had time.#7.5|Your Excellency, may I ask for a favor? Is there any open space in the Suitcase where I might let Qiangliang stretch its legs?#15.86

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 冬日里家乡寒冷，吃的也多是一些暖身子的食物，#0|像什么胡辣汤、油饼、油馍头、茶叶蛋、牛肉盒……那味道可中嘞！#5.07|咳，大人我是说，在下喜欢的是一些家乡菜。#14.79
character_voice.encontent: The winter is freezing back in my hometown; thankfully our local food is very hearty and warm.#0|Hulatang, Youbing, Youmotou, Tea Eggs, and Niurou Hezi ... just thinking of them makes my mouth water!#4.96|Ahem, I just mean that I like my hometown cuisine.#14.57

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 这里人妖精怪齐聚一堂，融洽无间，属实让我大开眼界。#0|真想让司内的大人们都瞧瞧这般景象，#5.29|毕竟若能习得一二管理之法，便也就不必成天焦头烂额。#8.63
character_voice.encontent: It is truly eye-opening to see so many people living in harmony.#0|I wish my supervisors could see and learn from the residents here.#4.28|A few well-applied management techniques could solve a lot of conflict.#8.76

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 大人，这些是我曾收集的一些小物件，并非什么名贵之物。#0|只是每每远行我便带在身边，待到思乡情浓时便会拿出来看上一看。#4.82|如今我在此可能要待上许久，请问我可以将它们存在这屋中吗？#10.59
character_voice.encontent: These? Nothing really, just some gadgets I've collected over the years.#0|I take them with me whenever I leave home. It helps me to stay connected with my roots.#5.7|As my mission may keep me here a long time, I humbly ask that I might place these in the lobby.#12.5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 我刚刚看到了一位挎着包的姑娘，她似乎在跟自己的挎包交流？不用管她吗？#0|是，在下只是觉得她总有些……行动太过敏捷。#7.1
character_voice.encontent: I just saw a girl talking to her handbag? Should I have left her alone? #0|I see. It's just ... she seems oddly agile.#6.3

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 在下年幼时，每逢月黑风高夜，便多恶人作祟，以致四邻不安，人人自危。#0|后我家遭贼，幸得师父相助。#6.8|事后我便跟着师父他入了北镇抚司。#9.98|只希望能惩恶扬善，有朝一日百姓夜不闭户，安享太平。#13.4
character_voice.encontent: When I was only a child, there was so much crime that we didn't feel safe to sleep through the night.#0|After my home was robbed, it was my master who arrived to help us.#6.5|I decided then and there that I must learn from him and join the North Zhenfu Division.#11.8|Now I help those in need and right their wrongs so that one day everyone, rich and poor alike, can sleep safely.#18.8

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 以前镇抚司办案，强调证据，若无明确罪证不得擅自抓人。#0|只是近来朝中越发浑浊，三公六部相互攻讦。#5.3|南北镇抚司亦不得不选边站队，这抓人的证据便也越发不重要了。#10.29|我受不得这些，恰逢司内要求彻查此案，我便接了差事来了这儿。#16.4
character_voice.encontent: With so much chaos in the Imperial Court, #0|conflict between my superiors and the other divisions became inevitable.#3.14|In time they stopped caring about evidence and justice; all that mattered was seeking glory or finding someone to blame.#8.6|I had almost given up hope, but with this mission, I finally have a chance to do my duty—the right way.#17.7

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 北镇抚司公办，闲人避让。#0
character_voice.encontent: North Zhenfu Division business. Make way.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 前方何人？#0
character_voice.encontent: Who's there?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 不必多言。#0
character_voice.encontent: Don't waste your breath.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 横锋护元。#0
character_voice.encontent: Keep your guard high.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 无奈之举，多有得罪。#0
character_voice.encontent: I must ask your pardon for this.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 破敌之策，了然于心。#0
character_voice.encontent: I have the means to destroy them.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 迅若脱兔！#0
character_voice.encontent: Swift as a hare!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 金石为开！#0
character_voice.encontent: Cleave through solid stone!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 紧则无密。#0
character_voice.encontent: A well-measured strike.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 疏则无缺。#0
character_voice.encontent: A flawless defense.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 险道逐疫，万恶皆除。强梁，出！#0
character_voice.encontent: Banish all evil and cleanse this place!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Urgh!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 放肆！#0
character_voice.encontent: How dare you!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 有什么话留到公堂再说吧。#0
character_voice.encontent: Save your words for the court.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 纵持“百兵之胆”，亦只能斩断眼前杂事。#0|然天下苍苍，作为梁家后人，自当为人前，为社稷，为苍生，争上一争。#4.3
character_voice.encontent: We call it the "General of Weapons," yet it is rare that I find a problem I can end with my sword alone.#0|But whether by a blade or any other tool, as a descendant of the Liang, it is my duty to protect the innocent.#8

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 师父刀法高强，当年就用一把官刀在我眼前做了一份蓑衣黄瓜……#0|今日事罢，我也试试，不知有无他老人家当日三分功力。#5.43
character_voice.encontent: My master is highly skilled with a blade. I once saw him slice up a cucumber salad in a single motion.#0|I should like to try that myself ... Hmm, but I fear I would only make a mess.#7.7

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 官府办事，闲人退避。我不是说大人您是闲人……咳，大人，这边请。#0
character_voice.encontent: No unauthorized visitors allowed—ah, Your Excellency, I didn't mean ... Ahem, right this way, please.#0

character_voice.content: 在下的刀法？要看的话，我怕此地施展不开……也罢，我试一试。#0
character_voice.encontent: You want me to demonstrate my skills? Given the space here, maybe there's another way to show you.#0

character_voice.name: 交互成功前半
character_voice.content: 那么在下献丑了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Well, if you insist.#0

character_voice.content: 这般如何？只是心中忽有形象，便雕了出来，#0|大人若是喜欢，尽可拿去。#4.21
character_voice.encontent: What do you think? It just came to my mind. #0|If you incline to keep it, be my guest.#4.4

skin.skinDescription: 刀下魑魅巷中走，阙上朗月照锦衣。
skin.skinStory:
论剑台边，月大如斗。
劲风如同一把剔骨尖刀，席卷而过。天边偶有寒鸦掠去，惊起一连串尖锐的啸声。
佩刀正在鞘中嗡鸣，鞘中封印着猛兽，名唤强梁，每逢恶战，便兴奋不已，兀自颤鸣。她拍了拍剑鞘，随即踏上最后一阶，而怀中密信所记载的线索，正指向这孤峰之顶的论剑台——这是绣坊主人交予她的密信。白马派剑谱一经出世，江湖之中风声鹤唳，正邪交锋再起，三教九流更是浑水摸鱼，最后连朝廷大员也命丧于此。
事关白马派剑谱一事，她不敢怠慢，连夜赶至此处。不知此时，一心想要金盆洗手的绣坊主人是否安好？
正值此刻，黑影从四面草石之中现形。为首之人虎视眈眈地望向她，正是线索中所载贼首。她心下了然，乍然间，虎啸随风起，长刀饮月光，这注定是不平静的一夜。

1251011.content: 报告长官，荒原一带全部巡逻完毕，请指示！
泥鯭的士小姐好像是这么称呼您的，您更习惯这种称呼么？
或者队长，组长，指挥官，老板？
意外时有发生，日常防范是不可或缺的，长官。
我刚才就看到一个小孩试图从五层楼高的塔上跳下来，还说自己会飞。
幸好我及时赶到，否则后果不堪设想。

1252011.content: 长官，有通电话希望您接一下。
是的，是强梁打来的，它点名要您听。
它说很感谢您这段时间的关照。
以后由我转达？可强梁比较想要亲自跟您说。
总之意思就是“多谢近日照拂”……

1251011.content: 这里很安全，不需要巡逻
